intro: Uganda is a green, landlocked country with lakes, mountains and the source of the White Nile.

chapters.title: Lakes and mountains
text: Uganda shares Lake Victoria, Africa's largest lake, where the White Nile begins at Jinja. The Rwenzori, the 'Mountains of the Moon', have glaciers on the equator. Murchison Falls squeezes the Nile through a 7 m gap.
Bwindi forest is home to about half the world's mountain gorillas.

chapters.title: Climate
text: High altitude makes the climate mild despite the equator.
